message.content: No, it did not take more than a week for Adam to remind LiHua about the contractor team installing the air-conditioner. The conversation took place within a span of a few days. Initially, Adam reached out to LiHua on August 10th at 18:00 to inquire about the ideal installation date for the air-conditioner, and he followed up again on August 12th at 11:00 to remind her that the contractor team was scheduled to install the air-conditioner in the basement at 6 PM that day. Therefore, the timeline indicates that the reminder occurred within less than a week of the initial inquiry.
